messages.text: Hi, I returned the glass kettle. Will the shipping I paid be refunded too, or just the kettle?

Shipping isn’t refunded automatically; the refund covers the amount paid for the kettle, not shipping (refund-policy/v2/shipping; refund-policy/v2/amount). If you’d like shipping reviewed, would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge?

continuation.content: Shipping isn’t refunded automatically; the refund covers the amount paid for the kettle, not shipping (refund-policy/v2/shipping; refund-policy/v2/amount). If you’d like shipping reviewed, would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge?

messages.text: No, thanks. Please go ahead with the refund for the kettle.
